turns.question: How many delivery-topic customer service calls were there per 100 shipped orders in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for calls per 100 shipped orders, so I cannot give that ratio; for September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) it counts 1 delivery-topic call (calls labelled, a model-derived count) and 50 shipped orders (orders, filtered to status shipped).
